revisions.description:
Lists or searches files.

This method returns all files by default, including deleted files. Use the 'trashed=false' query parameter to filter trashed files from the results.

changelog.reason: Service Account Key takes the whole JSON key file; Client Email and Private Key stay for revisions that use them; Corpora and Drive ID now reach the request, so a shared drive can be listed

params.label: Service Account Key
params.helpertext: The service account's whole JSON key file, pasted as-is. Replaces Client Email and Private Key
params.name: serviceAccountKey

params.label: Private Key
params.helpertext: The service account's private key. Not needed when Service Account Key is set
params.name: privateKey

params.label: Client Email
params.helpertext: The service account's client email. Not needed when Service Account Key is set
params.name: clientEmail

params.label: Query
params.helpertext: A query for filtering the file results
params.name: query

params.description: Supported groupings are: 'user', 'drive', 'domain', and 'allDrives' (A combination of 'user' and 'drive' for all drives where the user is a member).
params.label: Corpora
params.helpertext: Groupings of files to which the query applies.
params.name: corpora

params.label: Drive ID
params.helpertext: ID of the shared drive to search.
params.name: driveId

results.description: An array of file objects based on the listing query.
results.name: results
